description: This file contains comparator functions for images, text, and buffers used in testing or validation within the project. It provides mechanisms to compare image buffers (PNG and JPEG), text strings, and arbitrary buffers, with support for customized options and detailed error reporting.

methods.name: export function getComparator(mimeType: string): Comparator { getComparator
methods.description: Returns a comparator function based on the MIME type of the data, selecting between image, text, or buffer comparison.

methods.name: export function compareBuffersOrStrings(actualBuffer: Buffer | string, expectedBuffer: Buffer): / compareBuffersOrStrings
methods.description: Compares two buffers or strings, returning null if they are identical or an error message if they differ.

methods.name: function compareImages(mimeType: string, actualBuffer: Buffer | string, expectedBuffer: Buffer, / compareImages
methods.description: Compares two images (as buffers) with options for size and pixel differences. Returns a diff buffer and error message if images do not match.

methods.name: validateBuffer
methods.description: Checks if the provided buffer has the correct file signature for PNG or JPEG images.

methods.name: compareText
methods.description: Compares two text strings, producing a colored diff patch if they differ.
